correctness.rationale: Contracting the prescribed matching is a bijection of tree completions with spanning trees of the resulting multigraph, even for permutation cycles of length \(2\). Its Laplacian is \(L=2(n-1)I-2J+P_\sigma+P_\sigma^{\mathsf T}\), where \(P_\sigma\) is the permutation matrix. Fourier decomposition on permutation cycles yields one zero eigenvalue, \(c-1\) eigenvalues \(2n\), and internal eigenvalues \(2(n-1)+2\cos(2\pi h/\ell)\). Kirchhoff’s identity and the Chebyshev characteristic polynomial give the claimed product for every \(n\ge3\). The original crown Laplacian independently yields \(\tau(\operatorname{Cr}_n)=(n-1)n^{n-2}(n-2)^{n-1}\). The checker compares exact determinants for all 2174 derangements with \(3\le n\le7\), and exhaustive original-graph spanning-tree extensions for all 55 derangements with \(3\le n\le5\). These finite tests corroborate rather than prove the formula for unbounded orders.

originality.rationale: An explicit completion count conditional on a specific perfect matching of the matching-deleted complete bipartite graph is not asserted in the closest inspected full-text work. General matrix-tree/contraction methods and the preexisting unconditional tree count are expressly excluded from the originality claim. The formula distinguishes matching cycle types; the nearest complete-bipartite fixed-matching theorem cannot yield a cycle-dependent value merely by substitution. A 1997 simple almost-complete-graph source may contain additional spectral techniques and was not fully accessible; residual risk is recorded, not treated as a proof of novelty.
residual_risks: The 1997 Gilbert–Myrvold full text was not obtained; its abstract studies simple almost-complete graph families with path/cycle deleted patterns, and unpublished explicit multigraph extensions cannot be excluded.
A general multivariate spanning-tree generating function or unindexed crown specialization might algebraically imply the same cycle-type expression, even without matching keywords.
No independent audit has been performed; same-model screening cannot certify priority.

value.rationale: A specified perfect matching is a natural spanning forest, and counting all its extensions to a spanning tree is a high-order edge-reliability statistic not encoded by total tree counts or individual effective resistances. A deleted matching breaks the symmetry of \(K_{n,n}\), producing distinct \(32\) and \(36\) extension counts for matchings of the same \(\operatorname{Cr}_4\). The cycle-type formula is uniform over every derangement and every \(n\ge3\) and explains those differences using a meaningful quotient multigraph and spectral decomposition, rather than a small isolated enumeration. No extremal ordering or arbitrary-forest generalization is claimed.
